points.description: States a valid application of broaching from the model answer, e.g. machining gears, splines, or slots/keyways for support, or custom precision machining in the automotive industry.
points.partial_credit: Vague application (e.g. 'machining parts' or 'precision work' with no specific example) earns 0.75.

points.description: Application is tied to the broaching process as shaping/cutting a profile or feature (e.g. internal splines, gear teeth, slots/keyways) or names the industry context (automotive, precision machining), giving a clear, specific use.
points.partial_credit: Only the general field is named without the feature, or feature without any context, earns 0.25.

rubric.notes: Full marks for one clear, correct application such as machining splines, gears, slots/keyways, or precision machining in the automotive industry; more than one is not needed. Part marks for a vague answer like 'precision machining' or 'making parts' with no specific feature. No marks for wrong applications (e.g. drilling holes only, welding, casting) or unrelated answers.
